info.title: JAZLA API
info.description:
Every route is under the /v1 prefix; the paths below include it.

Amounts are integer halalas; timestamps are UTC (ISO 8601).

Every error response has the ErrorResponseDto shape; clients branch on its code.

bearer.description: Access token from the authentication endpoints.

phone.description: A Saudi mobile number, in any usual form (05…, 5…, 9665…, +9665…), with Latin or Arabic digits.

audience.description: The application the user is signing in to.

expiresInSeconds.description: How long the code can be used, in seconds.

resendAfterSeconds.description: How long to wait before asking for another code, in seconds.

field.description: Dotted path of the invalid field.

constraints.description: Names of the failed checks (class-validator constraint names), stable and language-neutral.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code. Clients branch on it; it is never renamed or reused.

code.description: Stable error code. Clients branch on it; it is never renamed or reused.

message.description: Message for a person, in Arabic unless Accept-Language prefers English. Never branch on it.
message.example: The requested resource was not found.

details.description: More about the error. For VALIDATION_FAILED, the list of invalid fields; otherwise an object whose fields depend on the code.

requestId.description: Id of the request, also in the x-request-id response header. Quote it when reporting a problem.

phone.description: The phone number the code was requested for.

audience.description: The audience the code was requested for.

code.description: The code from the message: 4 to 8 digits, Latin or Arabic (٠ to ٩, ۰ to ۹). Surrounding spaces and invisible format characters (direction marks, zero-width characters) are ignored.

devicePlatform.description: The kind of client signing in.

deviceName.description: A name for the device, shown in the list of sessions.

audience.description: The one audience this sign-in is for.

organisationId.description: The vendor or kitchen the user acts for; null for customers and admins.

accessToken.description: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request.

accessTokenExpiresInSeconds.description: How long the access token lives, in seconds.

refreshToken.description: Exchanged once for a new pair when the access token expires. Keep it in secure storage.

refreshTokenExpiresInSeconds.description: How long the refresh token lives, in seconds.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token of the session.

commercialRegistrationNumber.description: The commercial registration number: 10 digits, Latin or Arabic.

logoUrl.description: The logo’s stable public URL; null without a logo.
